brief: Pick your vector DB in 60 seconds — 6 options compared on real workloads.

slots.title: Pinecone serverless
slots.subtitle: Fully managed vector search with metadata filtering and hybrid search out of the box.
slots.b1Body: Create an index without tuning shards or replicas manually.
slots.b2Body: Pay for queries and storage rather than provisioned nodes.
slots.b3Body: Ship fast when you need reliability without infrastructure.

slots.title: Weaviate modular
slots.subtitle: Vector+semantic search with GraphQL and built-in vectorizer modules.
slots.b1Body: Query vectors with familiar nested filters and aggregation.
slots.b2Body: Swap embeddings or generative models without migrations.
slots.b3Body: Combine sparse BM25 and dense vector scores automatically.

slots.title: pgvector inside
slots.subtitle: Store embeddings right beside your relational data with ACID guarantees.
slots.b1Body: Use existing Postgres connections and backup workflows.
slots.b2Body: Choose index types that trade build speed for recall.
slots.b3Body: Run filters across JSONB columns and vectors in one query.

slots.title: Qdrant fast
slots.subtitle: High performance vector search with payload filtering and distributed deployment.
slots.b1Body: Serve billion scale indexes without loading everything to RAM.
slots.b2Body: Apply payload constraints before vector similarity scoring.
slots.b3Body: Single binary or Kubernetes helm chart in minutes.

slots.title: Milvus enterprise
slots.subtitle: Distributed architecture designed for billion vector workloads and tiered storage.
slots.b1Body: Accelerate index creation with CUDA for faster inserts.
slots.b2Body: Keep hot vectors in memory and cold data on object storage.
slots.b3Body: Monitor partitions and query latency from a web UI.

slots.title: Chroma simple
slots.subtitle: Embedding database focused on developer speed and local prototyping.
slots.b1Body: pip install and persist vectors to disk with zero config.
slots.b2Body: Integrate with RAG pipelines using a one line wrapper.
slots.b3Body: Run tests locally without Docker or cloud credentials.

slots.ctaBody: Download the benchmark sheet and deploy the sample workload to your stack.
